title: Genesis 1–4
subtitle: Creation, Fall & First Generations
description: Creation of the universe, Adam and Eve in Eden, the Fall, and Cain and Abel.

title: Genesis 5
subtitle: Genealogy: Adam to Noah
description: Spans the ten patriarchs from Adam down to the birth of Noah and his sons.

title: Genesis 6–11
subtitle: Noah, Great Flood & Tower of Babel
description: The Great Deluge, God's covenant with Noah, and the dispersion of nations at Babel.

title: Genesis 12–50
subtitle: Patriarchs: Abraham, Isaac, Jacob & Joseph
description: The call of Abraham, the birth of Isaac and Jacob, and Joseph's rise in Egypt.

title: Job
subtitle: Patriarchal Era Trials & Wisdom
description: Job's suffering, debates with friends, and God's discourse on divine sovereignty.

title: Exodus
subtitle: Plagues, Red Sea, Law & Tabernacle
description: Moses leads Israel out of Egyptian slavery, receives the Ten Commandments, and builds the Tabernacle.

title: Leviticus
subtitle: Sacrificial Laws & Priesthood at Sinai
description: Instructions for Israel's offerings, purity laws, holy days, and the Day of Atonement.

title: Numbers
subtitle: Wilderness Wandering & Census
description: 38 years of wandering due to unbelief, ending at the plains of Moab.

title: Deuteronomy
subtitle: Moses' Final Speeches & Death
description: Renewal of the Sinai covenant for the new generation before entering the Promised Land.

title: Joshua
subtitle: Conquest & Division of Canaan
description: Crossing the Jordan, the Jericho campaign, and the allotment of land among the 12 tribes.

title: Judges 1–3
subtitle: Early Judges: Othniel, Ehud & Shamgar
description: The cycle of rebellion, oppression, and deliverance beginning after Joshua's death.

title: Judges 4–8
subtitle: Deborah, Barak & Gideon
description: Victory over Sisera under Deborah and Gideon's defeat of the Midianites with 300 men.

title: Judges 9–12
subtitle: Abimelech, Jephthah & Minor Judges
description: Civil strife under Abimelech and Jephthah's victory over the Ammonites.

title: Judges 13–16
subtitle: Samson vs. Philistines
description: The Nazirite judge Samson and his exploits against the Philistine oppressors.

title: Judges 17–21
subtitle: Epilogues of Moral & Tribal Anarchy
description: Micah's idol, the Danite migration, and the civil war against Benjamin.

title: Ruth
subtitle: Kinsman-Redeemer Story
description: Ruth's loyalty to Naomi and Boaz, leading to the ancestral line of King David.

title: 1 Samuel
subtitle: Samuel, King Saul & David's Anointing
description: Transition from judges to monarchy; Saul's reign and David's rise.

title: 2 Samuel
subtitle: Reign of King David
description: David's unification of Israel, the Davidic Covenant, Jerusalem as capital, and family trials.

title: Psalms
subtitle: Hymns, Prayers & Messianic Prophecies
description: Five books of Israel's worship poetry written by David, Asaph, the Sons of Korah, and Moses.

title: Proverbs
subtitle: Practical Wisdom & Instruction
description: Wisdom sayings primarily compiled by Solomon, Agur, and Lemuel.

title: Song of Solomon
subtitle: Love Poetry of Solomon
description: Poetic celebration of marital love, affection, and devotion.

title: Ecclesiastes
subtitle: Wisdom Reflections of Qoheleth
description: Solomon's reflections on the meaning of life, human labor, and fearing God.

title: 1 Kings
subtitle: Solomon's Reign to Divided Kingdom
description: Building the Temple, Solomon's death, kingdom split into Israel and Judah, and Elijah's ministry.

title: 2 Kings
subtitle: Elisha, Divided Kings to Exile
description: Elisha's miracles, the fall of Israel to Assyria (722 BC), and Judah's exile to Babylon (586 BC).

title: Jonah
subtitle: Prophetic Mission to Nineveh
description: Jonah attempts to flee God's call, experiences the great fish, and preaches to Assyria.

title: Amos
subtitle: Call for Social Justice & Judgment
description: Shepherd-prophet warning northern Israel against religious hypocrisy and injustice.

title: Hosea
subtitle: Unfaithfulness & Redeeming Love
description: Hosea's marriage to Gomer serves as a metaphor for God's steadfast love for rebellious Israel.

title: Micah
subtitle: Prophecy of Bethlehem & Messiah
description: Denounces exploitation in Israel and Judah while foretelling Messiah's birthplace in Bethlehem.

title: Isaiah
subtitle: Assyrian Crisis & Servant Songs
description: Major prophet warning Judah of exile while declaring future messianic salvation.

title: Nahum
subtitle: Judgment on Nineveh
description: Predicts the ultimate downfall and destruction of the cruel Assyrian empire.

title: Zephaniah
subtitle: The Day of the Lord Warning
description: Prophesies judgment coming on Judah and surrounding nations under King Josiah.

title: Habakkuk
subtitle: Dialogue on the Babylonian Threat
description: Questions why God uses wicked Babylon to discipline Judah; affirms 'the just shall live by faith'.

title: Jeremiah
subtitle: Weeping Prophet & New Covenant
description: Warns Jerusalem of Babylonian captivity for 40 years and promises the New Covenant.

title: Lamentations
subtitle: Mourning the Fall of Jerusalem
description: Five acrostic poems weeping over the ruined city and temple after the 586 BC siege.

title: Obadiah
subtitle: Condemnation of Edom
description: Shortest Old Testament book, rebuking Edom for celebrating Judah's tragic destruction.

title: Ezekiel
subtitle: Babylonian Exilic Visions & Restoration
description: Priestly prophet in Babylon detailing the departure and return of God's glory and dry bones.

title: Daniel
subtitle: Court Tales & Four Kingdom Visions
description: Faithfulness in Babylon (Lion's Den) and apocalyptic visions of future world empires.

title: 1 Chronicles
subtitle: Genealogies & Davidic Temple Setup
description: Post-exilic re-retelling of Israel's history focusing on David and temple ministry.

title: 2 Chronicles
subtitle: Solomon to Cyrus Decree
description: Focuses on the kings of Judah who honored God's temple up to Cyrus' proclamation.

title: Ezra 1–6
subtitle: First Return & Second Temple
description: Zerubbabel leads exiles back to rebuild the altar and temple in Jerusalem.

title: Haggai
subtitle: Exhortation to Rebuild the Temple
description: Encourages returned exiles to stop delaying temple construction and prioritize God.

title: Zechariah
subtitle: Post-Exilic Visions & Messianic King
description: Eight night visions encouraging Zerubbabel and Joshua; predicts Messiah on a donkey.

title: Esther
subtitle: Providential Preservation in Persia
description: Queen Esther and Mordecai foil Haman's plot to destroy the Jews, establishing Purim.

title: Ezra 7–10
subtitle: Second Return & Spiritual Revival
description: Ezra the scribe returns to teach the Law and confront intermarriage compromises.

title: Nehemiah
subtitle: Rebuilding Jerusalem's Walls
description: Cupbearer to Artaxerxes rebuilds Jerusalem's defensive walls in 52 days.

title: Malachi
subtitle: Final Old Testament Rebukes
description: Confronts dead orthodoxy, corrupt priests, and foretells Elijah's coming before Messiah.

title: Joel
subtitle: Locust Plague & Outpouring of Spirit
description: Uses a devastating locust swarm to call for repentance and prophesies the Holy Spirit.

title: Matthew
subtitle: Gospel of Messiah King
description: Written primarily for Jewish readers, emphasizing Jesus as fulfillment of OT prophecies.

title: Mark
subtitle: Gospel of Suffering Servant
description: Fast-paced account highlighting Jesus' actions, miracles, and ransom on the cross.

title: Luke
subtitle: Gospel of Son of Man
description: Detailed historical record emphasizing Jesus' compassion for outcast groups and all humanity.

title: John
subtitle: Gospel of Divine Son of God
description: Focuses on seven sign miracles and 'I AM' statements declaring Jesus' deity.

title: Acts
subtitle: Apostolic Era & Early Church Spread
description: Pentecost, Holy Spirit's arrival, Peter's ministry, and Paul's missionary journeys across the Roman Empire.

title: James
subtitle: Faith Exhibited in Action
description: Practical exhortation on living out genuine faith through speech, trials, and good works.

title: Galatians
subtitle: Christian Liberty vs. Legalism
description: Paul's passionate defense of salvation by grace through faith apart from Mosaic law.

title: 1 & 2 Thessalonians
subtitle: Hope in Christ's Return
description: Letters offering comfort regarding believers who died and clarifying the Second Coming.

title: 1 & 2 Corinthians
subtitle: Church Unity, Gifts & Resurrection
description: Addressing divisions, immorality, spiritual gifts, love, and Paul's apostolic authority.

title: Romans
subtitle: Systematic Gospel Exposition
description: Paul's masterwork on human sinfulness, justification, sanctification, and Israel's role.

title: Ephesians, Philippians, Colossians, Philemon
subtitle: Pauline Letters from Rome
description: Written from Roman imprisonment: Church unity, joy in Christ, supremacy of Jesus, and slave reconciliation.

title: 1 & 2 Timothy, Titus
subtitle: Church Governance & Sound Doctrine
description: Instructions for elders, deacons, combating heresy, and Paul's final words before martyrdom.

title: 1 & 2 Peter, Jude
subtitle: Perseverance & False Teachers
description: Encouraging Christians under Roman persecution and warning against destructive apostasy.

title: Hebrews
subtitle: Superiority of the New Covenant
description: Demonstrates Jesus' supremacy over angels, Moses, and Levitical priests.

title: 1, 2, 3 John
subtitle: Fellowship, Love & Assurance
description: Tests of true faith: loving brethren, obeying commandments, and holding true doctrine.

title: Revelation
subtitle: Apocalypse & Final Victory
description: John's visions on Patmos depicting tribulation, Christ's return, Judgment, and New Jerusalem.
